item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00000","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final value 500 after correctly expressing total hours as (10 * 5) * 4.","case2_error":"Adds four weeks to weekly hours instead of multiplying weekly hours by four.","reason":"The first supplies an unsupported number after a correct formula; the second explicitly uses an erroneous relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00001","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 8 * 5 as 35 instead of 40.","case2_error":"Uses the daily biscuit count as the weekly total, omitting the five-day factor.","reason":"The first miscalculates a correct expression; the second fails to convert a daily count into the requested weekly total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00002","case1_error":"Treats 12 more green apples as 12 green apples, omitting the red-apple baseline.","case2_error":"No mathematical error; correctly calculates 28 green apples and 44 apples altogether.","reason":"The second solution is correct, so both cases do not have diagnosable mathematical errors.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00003","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 16 + 28 as 40 instead of 44.","case2_error":"Treats the excess of 12 green apples as the entire green-apple count.","reason":"The first numerically miscalculates a correct expression; the second misrepresents the given comparison relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00004","case1_error":"Uses George's 45 oranges instead of Amelia's 15 apples as the baseline for adding five.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 15 + 5 as 21 instead of 20.","reason":"The first selects the wrong baseline in the comparison relation; the second numerically miscalculates the correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"}]}
